text_blocks.snippet: The Mediterranean diet has been shown to prevent or reduce arthritis inflammation.

The Mediterranean diet is rich in fruits, vegetables, whole grains, legumes, and healthy fats like olive oil and fatty fish. These foods are known to possess powerful anti-inflammatory properties. Research, like the MOLI-SANI study, has shown that those who closely followed the Mediterranean diet had lower levels of inflammatory markers in their blood than those who followed other diet patterns.
